question: Should Android expose ClawHub install and global skill enable/disable as an admin-capable Settings surface, and what admin-scope and ClawHub-warning UX must be present before merge?
rationale: The PR adds mobile initiation of gateway-host skill installation and global skill config mutation, so the permanent mobile operator trust boundary needs maintainer confirmation after the concrete blockers are fixed.

options.title: Proceed With Guarded Android Management
options.body: Keep the feature only if Android gates or reauthenticates admin-capable sessions, surfaces the Gateway's specific ClawHub warning before acknowledgement, and ships with real Android proof.

options.title: Defer Install From Android
options.body: Limit this PR to read-only status/search improvements and handle mobile install/toggle in a later owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Proceed With Guarded Android Management
recommendation.body: Keep the feature only if Android gates or reauthenticates admin-capable sessions, surfaces the Gateway's specific ClawHub warning before acknowledgement, and ships with real Android proof.
